AMENDMENT NO. 2 TO CREDIT AGREEMENT AND GUARANTY
This AMENDMENT NO. 2 TO CREDIT AGREEMENT AND GUARANTY, dated as of September 20, 2021 (this “ Amendment ”), is by and among INVITAE CORPORATION, a Delaware corporation (the “ Borrower ”), the Subsidiary Guarantors party hereto, the Lenders party hereto, and PERCEPTIVE CREDIT HOLDINGS III, LP, a Delaware limited partnership, as administrative agent for the Lenders (in such capacity, together with its successors and assigns, the “ Administrative Agent ”). Reference is made to the Credit Agreement and Guaranty, dated as of October 2, 2020, among the Borrower, certain subsidiaries of the Borrower from time to time party thereto, the lenders from time to time party thereto (the “ Lenders ”) and the Administrative Agent (as amended, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time, the “ Credit Agreement ”). Capitalized terms used herein without definition shall have the same meanings as set forth in the Credit Agreement, as amended by this Amendment.
RECITALS
WHEREAS, the Borrower has requested that the Administrative Agent and the Lenders amend clause (g) of Section 9.01 of the Credit Agreement; and
WHEREAS, the Administrative Agent and the Lenders are willing to do so on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth herein.
NOW, THEREFORE, the parties hereto hereby agree as follows:
ARTICLE I AMENDMENT TO CREDIT AGREEMENT; OTHER AGREEMENTS
SECTION 1.01. Amendment to the Credit Agreement . As of the Amendment Effective Date, the Credit Agreement is hereby amended as follows:
(a) clause (g) of Section 9.01 of the Credit Agreement is hereby amended and restated in its entirety to read as follows:
“(g) ordinary course of business equipment financing and leasing and Capital Lease Obligations; provided that (i) if secured, the collateral therefor consists solely of the assets being financed, the products and proceeds thereof and books and records related thereto, and (ii) the aggregate outstanding principal amount of such Indebtedness (inclusive of all Capital Lease Obligations) shall not exceed $50,000,000 (or the Equivalent Amount in other currencies) at any time;”
(b) the proviso to Section 9.01 of the Credit Agreement is hereby amended and restated in its entirety to read as follows:
“ provided that, in the case of Indebtedness permitted under clauses (g) , (i)(y) and (o) above, the aggregate amount of such Indebtedness shall in no event exceed $100,000,000 at any time outstanding.”
ARTICLE II
ACKNOWLEDGEMENT, AGREEMENT AND CONSENT
SECTION 2.01. Each Obligor confirms and agrees that, notwithstanding the effectiveness of this Amendment, the obligations of such Obligor under each Loan Document to which such Obligor is a party shall not be impaired and each Loan Document to which such Obligor is a party is, and shall continue to be, in full force and effect and is hereby confirmed and ratified in all respects.
SECTION 2.02. Each Obligor hereby acknowledges and agrees that the Guaranteed Obligations will include all Obligations under, and as defined in, the Credit Agreement as amended by this Amendment.
ARTICLE III
CONDITIONS PRECEDENT
SECTION 3.01. Conditions to Effectiveness of this Amendment . This Amendment shall become effective only upon, and shall be subject to, the prior or simultaneous satisfaction or waiver of each of the following conditions precedent in a manner reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agent (the date satisfaction of such conditions being referred to as the “ Amendment Effective Date ”):
(a) Executed Amendment . The Administrative Agent shall have received this Amendment, duly executed by the Borrower, the Subsidiary Guarantors, the Administrative Agent and each of the Lenders.
(b) Costs and Expenses, Etc . The Administrative Agent shall have received for its account and the account of each Lender all reasonable and documented fees, costs and expenses due and payable to them pursuant to Section 14.03 of the Credit Agreement (including the Administrative Agent’s and each Lender’s reasonable and documented legal fees and out-of-pocket expenses).
ARTICLE IV MISCELLANEOUS
SECTION 4.01. Governing Law; Jurisdiction; Jury Trial . This Amendment and the rights and obligations of the parties hereunder shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the law of the State of New York. The jurisdiction and waiver of jury trial provisions set forth in Sections 14.10 and 14.11 of the Credit Agreement, respectively, are incorporated herein by reference mutatis mutandis .
SECTION 4.02. Effect of Amendment .
(a) On and after the Amendment Effective Date, each reference in any Loan Document (other than this Amendment) to the Credit Agreement shall mean and be a reference to the Credit Agreement as amended by this Amendment.

# INVESTMENT MEMORANDUM

## Executive Summary

**Date of Agreement:** September 20, 2021

**Borrower/Company Overview:** Invitae Corporation, a Delaware corporation

**Transaction Description:** This is Amendment No. 2 to an existing Credit Agreement and Guaranty originally dated October 2, 2020. The transaction involves Invitae Corporation as borrower, multiple subsidiary guarantors, and Perceptive Credit Holdings III, LP serving as administrative agent and lender.

**Purpose of Financing:** The amendment specifically modifies covenant provisions related to permitted indebtedness for equipment financing, leasing, and capital lease obligations. The borrower requested amendments to clause (g) of Section 9.01 of the original Credit Agreement.

**Company Background:** Invitae Corporation operates with multiple subsidiaries including Genetic Solutions LLC, Good Start Genetics Inc., OmniDom Inc., YouScript LLC, ArcherDX LLC, ArcherDX Clinical Services Inc., Reference Genomics LLC, Genosity LLC, and MedNeon LLC, all of which serve as subsidiary guarantors under the facility.

## Investment Highlights & Risks

**Key Strengths/Credit Positives:**
• Multiple subsidiary guarantors provide enhanced credit support and broader obligor base
• Established credit relationship with original facility dating to October 2020
• Amendment represents borrower's proactive approach to covenant management
• Covenant modifications appear to provide additional operational flexibility for equipment financing needs

**Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:**
• Amendment increases permitted indebtedness limits, potentially weakening credit protection
• Equipment financing basket increased to $50 million from previous limit (amount N/A)
• Aggregate indebtedness cap across multiple baskets set at $100 million
• Risk mitigation: Equipment financing remains secured solely by financed assets and related collateral
